hook.name: PhiEthHooks
hook.description: A custom-curve hook implementing 1:1 ETH/phiEth swaps by intercepting beforeSwap, taking the full input from the pool manager, wrapping or unwrapping via the phiEth contract, and settling the output directly — bypassing the concentrated liquidity AMM entirely. Liquidity addition is blocked; only ETH/phiEth pools with zero fee are permitted.
